subject.title: fix(agents): allow empty-error-retry when replayMetadata is absent (#97877)

question: Should this PR be the canonical implementation for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97877, or should maintainers choose another open sibling PR for the same retry/session-state bug?
rationale: The patch is technically plausible and well covered, but several branches solve the same high-impact retry boundary and only one should land as the permanent behavior.

options.title: Use this PR as canonical
options.body: Refresh this branch if needed, let exact-head checks gate landing, then close the sibling candidates as superseded.

options.title: Choose a sibling PR
options.body: Keep this PR open only until the selected sibling proves equivalent per-attempt safety, server_error routing, and real behavior proof.

options.title: Pause for owner design review
options.body: Hold all candidates until an agent-runtime owner confirms the permanent per-attempt replay metadata contract.

recommendation.title: Use this PR as canonical
recommendation.body: Refresh this branch if needed, let exact-head checks gate landing, then close the sibling candidates as superseded.

likelyOwner.reason: The best available history signal shows recent merge and adjacent ownership of the same embedded-runner retry/session surface.
